column1: # Symposium old -> new paragraph map. Applies identically to original-en and modern-en.
# Coordinates: chapter number (1-based) . paragraph index (0-based), matching reader chapterNumber/paragraphIndex.

# Old = served baseline at main 38a97c6315fdad4fe01fe326c203f870e22e615b (original-en sha256 e2943777fd54eaaa0888076c5c03a9104bc1b1ffa681a5362ab114e327f797c0, modern-en sha256 7816d1eb6ac9cc6d178c4c123bbeb8ad6daced1f7d7fc8c036f2bded3b8fcce8).
# No paragraph is merged, split or deleted, so offset_shift_* is 0 on every row (the columns keep the format read by prepare-structural-migration.py).
# Text is carried byte for byte (old hash == new hash) except modern-en 3.3, 3.7, 3.8 (C-06), marked text_changed=modern-en:
#   for those three, use mapping/changed-paragraph-ops.json (UTF-16 char and word opcodes) to project offsets.
# op: keep = same coordinate; renumber = same chapter, new index (+9 in chapter 1); move = new chapter (7.69-7.114 -> 8.0-8.45; 8.0 -> 8.46).
# New coordinates 1.0-1.8 have no old coordinate: they are the restored passages listed in inserted-paragraphs.tsv.
